title: Refresh page rendering settings after admin configuration changes
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that FilePageService is singleton-created from IOptions.Value and caches AllowRawHtml and DefaultMinimumRole, while AdminSettingsService reloads the override file. Page rendering and new-page defaults remain stale after a successful admin update. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Hosting/MemorySmithStorageSetup.cs, Services/PageService.cs, Services/AdminSettingsService.cs. Use monitor-backed options or explicit invalidation and test no-restart updates.
